comment: Rows captured from src/main/web/{devices-store,blocks-store,serve-secret}.ts before they moved to the core (12 Nov 2026). devicesWritten is the file as the stores wrote it while they ran (members in creation order); devices is the same list written again after a reload (the schema's order); cookies belong to devicesWritten/devices; verdicts are blocks.check over a grid of visitors.
